Ana (PM): Quick sync — post-launch iteration plan proposal: split this cycle into P0-2 bug blitz (60% capacity) + 40% runway for high-impact enhancements/customer asks. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Mike (Eng): sounds reasonable. do we have a list of P0s that block customers?
Ana (PM): yes — top three from support: 1) streaming stutters for long responses (customer A) 2) embed export mismatch (customer B) 3) third-party auth edge-case. I'll paste short notes.
Ana (PM): streaming stutters: reproducible when >8k tokens, p99 latency spikes. impact: heavy for demo flows.
Ana (PM): embed export mismatch: CSV header ordering inconsistent when locale=en-GB. causes ingestion issues for customers.
Mike (Eng): I'll own streaming stutters. likely batching / KV cache edge. estimate 2 dev-days + 1 day to stress test.
Jules (QA): I can start triage steps and create repro harness for streaming. Will ask for sample transcript from customer A — @Ravi can you fetch?
Ravi (SE): on it, I have the logs. will upload to the thread and mark with `customer-A-stream.log`.
Sasha (Design): for embed export mismatch — small schema change, but needs signoff for UX in export dialog. I'll draft a micro spec and screenshot.
Ana (PM): Good. For enhancements: customer B asked for a scheduled export endpoint (cron-style) — value high but effort non-trivial. Proposal: treat as enhancement candidate for next sprint if we can get embed CSV stable this week.
Mike (Eng): scheduling endpoint estimate ~3 dev-days + infra config. Can we scope MVP: today -> accept webhook + `cron` field, later add UI?
Ana (PM): yes MVP = webhook + cron expression. no UI in cycle.
Jules (QA): test plan notes: repro harness for streaming, cross-locale CSV tests, cron webhook smoke test. I'll attach test cases to the ticket.
Ravi (SE): customer-B is okay with webhook-only MVP. they prefer ETA not open-ended.
Ana (PM): Decision: allocate 60% to P0-2 bugs (streaming + CSV + auth edge), 40% to two enhancement spikes (scheduled export MVP + infra hardening). Mike will own streaming + infra. Sasha will own CSV UX + signoff. Jules -> QA lead. Ravi -> customer comms.
Mike (Eng): concur. will open PRs and tag `release/next` branch.
Sasha (Design): I'll drop mock and `export-v2-spec.md` in the ticket by EOD.
Jules (QA): starting smoke runs now. will flag blocking repros by lunchtime. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 2024-05-14T21:00Z if PRs merged and CI green.
Ana (PM): final call: keep scope tight, no bolt-on features. if streaming fix slips, we’ll pause the scheduled export work. OK?
Mike (Eng): OK. syncing with infra to ensure canary capacity.
Ravi (SE): I'll update the customer timeline and share this thread.
Ana (PM): thanks — will update roadmap board and tag stakeholders. :white_check_mark:
